def imt(token, i=None, m=None, t=None):
    """Helper function to simplify comparisons Instance, Match and TokenType
    :param token:
    :param i: Class or Tuple/List of Classes
    :param m: Tuple of TokenType & Value. Can be list of Tuple for multiple
    :param t: TokenType or Tuple/List of TokenTypes
    :return:  bool
    """
    if token is None:
        return False
    if i and isinstance(token, i):
        return True
    if m:
        if isinstance(m, list):
            if any(token.match(*pattern) for pattern in m):
                return True
        elif token.match(*m):
            return True
    if t:
        if isinstance(t, list):
            if any(token.ttype in ttype for ttype in t):
                return True
        elif token.ttype in t:
            return True
    return False

def recurse(*cls):
    """Function decorator to help with recursion

    :param cls: Classes to not recurse over
    :return: function
    """
    def wrap(f):
        def wrapped_f(tlist):
            for sgroup in tlist.get_sublists():
                if not isinstance(sgroup, cls):
                    wrapped_f(sgroup)
            f(tlist)

        return wrapped_f

    return wrap

def imt(token, i=None, m=None, t=None):
    """Helper function to simplify comparisons Instance, Match and TokenType
    :param token:
    :param i: Class or Tuple/List of Classes
    :param m: Tuple of TokenType & Value. Can be list of Tuple for multiple
    :param t: TokenType or Tuple/List of TokenTypes
    :return:  bool
    """
    if token is None:
        return False
    if i and isinstance(token, i):
        return True
    if m:
        if isinstance(m, list):
            if any(token.match(*pattern) for pattern in m):
                return True
        elif token.match(*m):
            return True
    if t:
        if isinstance(t, list):
            if any(token.ttype in ttype for ttype in t):
                return True
        elif token.ttype in t:
            return True
    return False

def recurse(*cls):
    """Function decorator to help with recursion

    :param cls: Classes to not recurse over
    :return: function
    """
    def wrap(f):
        def wrapped_f(tlist):
            for sgroup in tlist.get_sublists():
                if not isinstance(sgroup, cls):
                    wrapped_f(sgroup)
            f(tlist)

        return wrapped_f

    return wrap

    return TokenList(tokens)

    tokens = list(lexer.tokenize(sql_text))
    from sqlparse.sql import TokenList
    return TokenList(tokens)

class TestGroupMatching:
    def test_group_brackets(self):
        tl = _flat("[a b]")
        group_brackets(tl)
        groups = [t for t in tl.tokens if isinstance(t, sql.SquareBrackets)]
        assert len(groups) == 1
        assert groups[0].value == "[a b]"

    def test_group_parenthesis(self):
        tl = _flat("(a b)")
        group_parenthesis(tl)
        groups = [t for t in tl.tokens if isinstance(t, sql.Parenthesis)]
        assert len(groups) == 1
        assert groups[0].value == "(a b)"

    def test_group_nested_parenthesis(self):
        tl = _flat("((a))")
        group_parenthesis(tl)
        outer = [t for t in tl.tokens if isinstance(t, sql.Parenthesis)]
        assert len(outer) == 1
        outer = outer[0]
        inner = [t for t in outer.tokens if isinstance(t, sql.Parenthesis)]
        assert len(inner) == 1

    def test_group_case(self):
        tl = _flat("CASE WHEN a THEN b ELSE c END")
        group_case(tl)
        cases = [t for t in tl.tokens if isinstance(t, sql.Case)]
        assert len(cases) == 1
        assert cases[0].value.startswith("CASE")

    def test_group_if(self):
        tl = _flat("IF a THEN b END")
        group_if(tl)
        groups = [t for t in tl.tokens if isinstance(t, sql.If)]
        assert len(groups) == 1

    def test_group_for(self):
        tl = _flat("FOR i IN 1..10 LOOP END LOOP")
        group_for(tl)
        groups = [t for t in tl.tokens if isinstance(t, sql.For)]
        assert len(groups) == 1

    def test_group_begin(self):
        tl = _flat("BEGIN SELECT 1; END")
        group_begin(tl)
        groups = [t for t in tl.tokens if isinstance(t, sql.Begin)]
        assert len(groups) == 1

    def test_unbalanced_close_ignored(self):
        tl = _flat(") (")
        group_parenthesis(tl)
        # No group created because first is close (unmatched), second open.
        groups = [t for t in tl.tokens if isinstance(t, sql.Parenthesis)]
        assert groups == []

        tl = _flat("")
        group_parenthesis(tl)

def imt(token, i=None, m=None, t=None):
    """Helper function to simplify comparisons Instance, Match and TokenType
    :param token:
    :param i: Class or Tuple/List of Classes
    :param m: Tuple of TokenType & Value. Can be list of Tuple for multiple
    :param t: TokenType or Tuple/List of TokenTypes
    :return:  bool
    """
    if token is None:
        return False
    if i and isinstance(token, i):
        return True
    if m:
        if isinstance(m, list):
            if any(token.match(*pattern) for pattern in m):
                return True
        elif token.match(*m):
            return True
    if t:
        if isinstance(t, list):
            if any(token.ttype in ttype for ttype in t):
                return True
        elif token.ttype in t:
            return True
    return False

def recurse(*cls):
    """Function decorator to help with recursion

    :param cls: Classes to not recurse over
    :return: function
    """
    def wrap(f):
        def wrapped_f(tlist):
            for sgroup in tlist.get_sublists():
                if not isinstance(sgroup, cls):
                    wrapped_f(sgroup)
            f(tlist)

        return wrapped_f

    return wrap

def make_tlist(*tokens):
    """Build a TokenList from flat token objects."""
    tlist = sql.TokenList(list(tokens))
    return tlist

    return Token(ttype, value)

    return [t.ttype for t in tlist.tokens]


def classes_of(tlist):
    return [type(t).__name__ for t in tlist.tokens]

# group_begin  (all via _group_matching)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def test_group_brackets_simple():
    tlist = make_tlist(
        tok(T.Name, 'a'),
        tok(T.Punctuation, '['),
        tok(T.Name, 'b'),
        tok(T.Punctuation, ']'),
    )
    grouping.group_brackets(tlist)
    assert len(tlist.tokens) == 2
    assert isinstance(tlist.tokens[1], sql.SquareBrackets)
    assert tlist.tokens[1].value == '[b]'


def test_group_parenthesis_simple():
    tlist = make_tlist(
        tok(T.Name, 'f'),
        tok(T.Punctuation, '('),
        tok(T.Name, 'x'),
        tok(T.Punctuation, ')'),
    )
    grouping.group_parenthesis(tlist)
    assert len(tlist.tokens) == 2
    assert isinstance(tlist.tokens[1], sql.Parenthesis)
    assert tlist.tokens[1].value == '(x)'


def test_group_parenthesis_nested():
    tlist = make_tlist(
        tok(T.Punctuation, '('),
        tok(T.Punctuation, '('),
        tok(T.Name, 'x'),
        tok(T.Punctuation, ')'),
        tok(T.Punctuation, ')'),
    )
    grouping.group_parenthesis(tlist)
    assert len(tlist.tokens) == 1
    outer = tlist.tokens[0]
    assert isinstance(outer, sql.Parenthesis)

    assert isinstance(outer.tokens[0], sql.Parenthesis)

    tlist = make_tlist(

        tok(T.Name, 'b'),

def imt(token, i=None, m=None, t=None):
    """Helper function to simplify comparisons Instance, Match and TokenType
    :param token:
    :param i: Class or Tuple/List of Classes
    :param m: Tuple of TokenType & Value. Can be list of Tuple for multiple
    :param t: TokenType or Tuple/List of TokenTypes
    :return:  bool
    """
    if token is None:
        return False
    if i and isinstance(token, i):
        return True
    if m:
        if isinstance(m, list):
            if any(token.match(*pattern) for pattern in m):
                return True
        elif token.match(*m):
            return True
    if t:
        if isinstance(t, list):
            if any(token.ttype in ttype for ttype in t):
                return True
        elif token.ttype in t:
            return True
    return False

def recurse(*cls):
    """Function decorator to help with recursion

    :param cls: Classes to not recurse over
    :return: function
    """
    def wrap(f):
        def wrapped_f(tlist):
            for sgroup in tlist.get_sublists():
                if not isinstance(sgroup, cls):
                    wrapped_f(sgroup)
            f(tlist)

        return wrapped_f

    return wrap

def imt(token, i=None, m=None, t=None):
    """Helper function to simplify comparisons Instance, Match and TokenType
    :param token:
    :param i: Class or Tuple/List of Classes
    :param m: Tuple of TokenType & Value. Can be list of Tuple for multiple
    :param t: TokenType or Tuple/List of TokenTypes
    :return:  bool
    """
    if token is None:
        return False
    if i and isinstance(token, i):
        return True
    if m:
        if isinstance(m, list):
            if any(token.match(*pattern) for pattern in m):
                return True
        elif token.match(*m):
            return True
    if t:
        if isinstance(t, list):
            if any(token.ttype in ttype for ttype in t):
                return True
        elif token.ttype in t:
            return True
    return False

def imt(token, i=None, m=None, t=None):
    """Helper function to simplify comparisons Instance, Match and TokenType
    :param token:
    :param i: Class or Tuple/List of Classes
    :param m: Tuple of TokenType & Value. Can be list of Tuple for multiple
    :param t: TokenType or Tuple/List of TokenTypes
    :return:  bool
    """
    if token is None:
        return False
    if i and isinstance(token, i):
        return True
    if m:
        if isinstance(m, list):
            if any(token.match(*pattern) for pattern in m):
                return True
        elif token.match(*m):
            return True
    if t:
        if isinstance(t, list):
            if any(token.ttype in ttype for ttype in t):
                return True
        elif token.ttype in t:
            return True
    return False

def recurse(*cls):
    """Function decorator to help with recursion

    :return: function

    def wrap(f):
        def wrapped_f(tlist):
            for sgroup in tlist.get_sublists():
                if not isinstance(sgroup, cls):
                    wrapped_f(sgroup)
            f(tlist)

def imt(token, i=None, m=None, t=None):
    """Helper function to simplify comparisons Instance, Match and TokenType
    :param token:
    :param i: Class or Tuple/List of Classes
    :param m: Tuple of TokenType & Value. Can be list of Tuple for multiple
    :param t: TokenType or Tuple/List of TokenTypes
    :return:  bool
    """
    if token is None:
        return False
    if i and isinstance(token, i):
        return True
    if m:
        if isinstance(m, list):
            if any(token.match(*pattern) for pattern in m):
                return True
        elif token.match(*m):
            return True
    if t:
        if isinstance(t, list):
            if any(token.ttype in ttype for ttype in t):
                return True
        elif token.ttype in t:
            return True
    return False

def recurse(*cls):
    """Function decorator to help with recursion

    :param cls: Classes to not recurse over
    :return: function
    """
    def wrap(f):
        def wrapped_f(tlist):
            for sgroup in tlist.get_sublists():
                if not isinstance(sgroup, cls):
                    wrapped_f(sgroup)
            f(tlist)

        return wrapped_f

    return wrap

"""Unit tests for sqlparse.engine.grouping.

These tests exercise the public API of the module directly at the
token-list level.  A helper parses SQL into a flat token list (without
applying any grouping) so we have full control over what each grouping
function sees.
"""

import pytest

from sqlparse import sql, tokens as T
from sqlparse.engine import grouping
from sqlparse.engine.grouping import (
    group_brackets,
    group_parenthesis,
    group_case,
    group_if,
    group_for,
    group_begin,
    group_typecasts,
    group_tzcasts,
    group_typed_literal,
    group_period,
    group_as,
    group_assignment,
    group_comparison,
    group_identifier,
    group_over,
    group_arrays,
    group_operator,
    group_identifier_list,
    group_comments,
    group_where,
    group_aliased,
    group_functions,
    group_order,
    align_comments,
    group_values,
    group,
)
from sqlparse.exceptions import SQLParseError
from sqlparse.tokens import Token as _Token  # noqa: F401  (namespace sanity)
from sqlparse.lexer import Lexer


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def lex(sql_text):
    """Return a flat token list (no grouping) for the given SQL text."""
    return list(Lexer.get_default_instance().get_tokens(sql_text))


def values(tlist):
    return [tok.value for tok in tlist.tokens]


def classnames(tlist):
    return [type(tok).__name__ for tok in tlist.tokens]


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# _group_matching based groupings
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def test_group_brackets():
    tlist = lex("SELECT [a, b] FROM x")
    group_brackets(tlist)
    assert classnames(tlist) == [
        "Token", "Token", "SquareBrackets", "Token", "Token",
    ]
    assert values(tlist)[2] == "[a, b]"


def test_group_brackets_unbalanced():
    # A lone closing bracket is ignored (no exception raised).
    tlist = lex("a ] b")
    group_brackets(tlist)
    assert values(tlist) == ["a", " ", "]", " ", "b"]
    assert all(not isinstance(t, sql.SquareBrackets) for t in tlist.tokens)


def test_group_parenthesis():
    tlist = lex("foo(a, b)")
    group_parenthesis(tlist)
    assert any(isinstance(t, sql.Parenthesis) for t in tlist.tokens)
    parens = [t for t in tlist.tokens if isinstance(t, sql.Parenthesis)]
    assert len(parens) == 1
    assert parens[0].value == "(a, b)"


def test_group_parenthesis_nested():
    tlist = lex("(a (b) c)")
    group_parenthesis(tlist)
    outer = [t for t in tlist.tokens if isinstance(t, sql.Parenthesis)]
    assert len(outer) == 1
    assert outer[0].value == "(a (b) c)"


def test_group_parenthesis_extra_close():
    tlist = lex("(a))")
    group_parenthesis(tlist)
    parens = [t for t in tlist.tokens if isinstance(t, sql.Parenthesis)]
    assert len(parens) == 1
    assert parens[0].value == "(a)"


def test_group_case():
    tlist = lex("CASE WHEN a THEN b ELSE c END")
    group_case(tlist)
    cases = [t for t in tlist.tokens if isinstance(t, sql.Case)]
    assert len(cases) == 1
    assert cases[0].value == "CASE WHEN a THEN b ELSE c END"


def test_group_case_unbalanced():
    tlist = lex("CASE WHEN a THEN b")
    group_case(tlist)
    assert all(not isinstance(t, sql.Case) for t in tlist.tokens)


def test_group_if():
    tlist = lex("IF a THEN b END")
    group_if(tlist)
    ifs = [t for t in tlist.tokens if isinstance(t, sql.If)]
    assert len(ifs) == 1
    assert ifs[0].value == "IF a THEN b END"


def test_group_for():
    tlist = lex("FOR x IN a END")
    group_for(tlist)
    fors = [t for t in tlist.tokens if isinstance(t, sql.For)]
    assert len(fors) == 1
    assert fors[0].value == "FOR x IN a END"


def test_group_begin():
    tlist = lex("BEGIN SELECT 1 END")
    group_begin(tlist)
    begins = [t for t in tlist.tokens if isinstance(t, sql.Begin)]
    assert len(begins) == 1
    assert begins[0].value == "BEGIN SELECT 1 END"

def test_group_typecasts():
    tlist = lex("foo::int")
    group_typecasts(tlist)
    ids = [t for t in tlist.tokens if isinstance(t, sql.Identifier)]
    assert len(ids) == 1
    assert ids[0].value == "foo::int"


def test_group_typecasts_multiple():
    tlist = lex("a::int::text")
    group_typecasts(tlist)
    ids = [t for t in tlist.tokens if isinstance(t, sql.Identifier)]
    assert len(ids) >= 1
    assert any(t.value == "a::int" for t in ids)

def test_group_tzcasts():
    tlist = lex("UPDATE foo SET x = 1::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'")
    group_tzcasts(tlist)
    # The AT TIME ZONE keyword should be grouped into an Identifier
    # with the datetime literal before it.
    found = any(

        for t in tlist.tokens

    tlist = lex("DATE '2020-01-01'")
    group_typed_literal(tlist)
    lits = [t for t in tlist.tokens if isinstance(t, sql.TypedLiteral)]
    assert len(lits) == 1
    assert lits[0].value == "DATE '2020-01-01'"

def imt(token, i=None, m=None, t=None):
    """Helper function to simplify comparisons Instance, Match and TokenType
    :param token:
    :param i: Class or Tuple/List of Classes
    :param m: Tuple of TokenType & Value. Can be list of Tuple for multiple
    :param t: TokenType or Tuple/List of TokenTypes
    :return:  bool
    """
    if token is None:
        return False
    if i and isinstance(token, i):
        return True
    if m:
        if isinstance(m, list):
            if any(token.match(*pattern) for pattern in m):
                return True
        elif token.match(*m):
            return True
    if t:
        if isinstance(t, list):
            if any(token.ttype in ttype for ttype in t):
                return True
        elif token.ttype in t:
            return True
    return False

def recurse(*cls):
    """Function decorator to help with recursion

    :param cls: Classes to not recurse over
    :return: function
    """
    def wrap(f):
        def wrapped_f(tlist):
            for sgroup in tlist.get_sublists():
                if not isinstance(sgroup, cls):
                    wrapped_f(sgroup)
            f(tlist)

        return wrapped_f

    return wrap

def test_group_matching_recurses_into_group():
    # Build a token list where a Parenthesis is inside an existing group
    inner = sql.Token(T.Name, 'a')
    par = sql.Parenthesis([inner])
    # Wrap par inside a comparison, which is a different class
    comp = sql.Comparison([par])
    tl = sql.TokenList([comp])
    grouping._group_matching(tl, sql.Parenthesis)
    # Should not raise and should recurse into Comparison
    assert isinstance(tl.tokens[0], sql.Comparison)


def test_group_matching_skips_whitespace():
